I have built a UV-textured 3D version of the **Medieval Guildhall & Bell Tower** from your reference image (`4,836` triangles / `14,508` vertices, mobile-optimized for iPad) and integrated it into the 3D studio with one-click **GLB**, **OBJ**, and **2K Texture Atlas PNG** export for **Xogot Engine** on iPad.

### What Was Built

1. **Detailed 3D Medieval Guildhall Geometry ([js/medieval-house.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/medieval-house.js))**
   - **Ground Floor & Entrance Portal**: Rusticated ashlar stone walls, alternating corner quoins, fluted entrance pilasters, semicircular carved tympanum arch with keystone crest, double wooden doors with iron studs and brass ring knockers, glowing wall lanterns, and a 5-step stone staircase with stepped balustrades.
   - **Upper Half-Timbered Hall & Balcony Loggia**: Cream stucco with dark oak timber framing (vertical posts, horizontal rails, diagonal braces), projecting front gable with a golden heraldic shield, and an open second-floor arcaded balcony loggia with stone balusters and timber columns.
   - **Roofs, Dormers & Weathervanes**: Steep terracotta tile main roof, contrasting blue-grey slate cross-gable roof, two gabled dormer windows, two stone chimneys with clay pots, and wrought-iron weathervanes (`W-E` / `W-N`).
   - **Clock & Bell Tower + Oriel Window**: Rear-right stone and timber tower wing featuring a projecting hexagonal stained-glass oriel bay window on a corbel bracket, a stone belfry with an arched opening and hanging bronze bell, a Roman-numeral clock face on the right facade, and a pointed octagonal slate spire.
   - **Courtyard Props & Banners**: Covered left-side timber lean-to porch, stone water trough with spout, wooden bench, bollards with hanging iron chains, 5 crimson-and-gold royal banners (lion & broadsword emblems), stone flower planters, wooden crates, barrels, and a roofed courtyard quest/notice board.

2. **2048×2048 Procedural UV Texture Atlas ([js/medieval-house.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/medieval-house.js))**
   - A 16-tile (`4×4` grid of `512×512` tiles) hand-painted style texture atlas mapped via non-overlapping UVs to every architectural element.

3. **Xogot Engine (Godot 4 on iPad) Exporters ([js/exporters.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/exporters.js), [index.html](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/index.html), [js/app.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/app.js))**
   - **📦 Export GLB (Xogot)**: Click **`Export GLB (Xogot)`** in the top bar (or inside the **Model** / **Xogot Export** tabs) to download `medieval_guildhall.glb`—a single binary glTF 2.0 file with the 3D mesh, normals, UVs, and embedded `2048×2048` PNG PBR texture atlas ready to drop directly into your Xogot project on iPad.
   - **🎨 Export 2K Texture Atlas (.png)** & **📐 Export Wavefront OBJ (.obj)**: Also available in the **Xogot Export** tab if you want to inspect or customize the texture sheet separately.

Your changes have been committed and saved (`Build 3D Guild Hall model from architectural blueprint elevations & ground floor plan`), and the 3D Guild Hall model has been updated in Three.js to match both your **Architectural Blueprint & Elevations** ([photo-1792348449-1.jpg](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/images/photo-1792348449-1.jpg)) and **Reference Artwork** ([photo-1792348478-2.jpg](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/images/photo-1792348478-2.jpg)).

### What Was Added & Committed
- **Complete 4-Sided Blueprint Elevations ([js/medieval-house.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/medieval-house.js))**:
  - **Front Elevation (`18m` width × `16.2m` tower apex)**: Arched stone entrance portal, 5-step wide stairs with stone balustrades, carved tympanum & keystone shield, projecting half-timbered gable with golden heraldic crest, left & right roof dormers, crimson banners, and `1.8m` covered outdoor shelter (`VERIINKA`) with water trough and bench.
  - **Rear Elevation**: Projecting rear stone bay and jettied second-floor half-timbered cross-gable supported by 6 carved stone corbel brackets, rear stairwell & hall windows, and twin-pot stone chimney stack.
  - **Left Side Elevation**: Ground-floor ashlar stone wall with two symmetrical stone-framed windows, 7 jettied overhang corbel brackets, second-floor central casement window, half-timbered gable apex with weathervane (`W-E`), and arched veranda post braces.
  - **Right Side Elevation**: Two large arched ground-floor windows separated by stone pilasters, 3-bay second-floor arcaded balcony loggia with upper gable window, projecting polygonal stained-glass oriel window on corbels, and the `16.2m` clock & bell tower (`XII–III–VI–IX` clock face + hanging bronze bell).
- **3D Ground Floor Plan Cutaway Mode ([index.html](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/index.html), [js/mesh-generators.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/mesh-generators.js), [js/app.js](https://github.com/neilvk25-prog/i-already-have-a-project/blob/main/js/app.js))**:
  - Switch between **🏰 Full Guild Hall & Clock Tower** and **📐 Ground Floor Plan (3D Interior Cutaway)** in the **Model** tab to inspect the `14.5m × 11m` interior layout (Great Hall with 4 corner stone pillars, left/right side rooms, east bay window alcove, and rear U-shaped switchback staircase).
  - Use the bottom-right camera dock (**`ISO`**, **`FRONT`**, **`RIGHT`**, **`REAR`**, **`LEFT`**, **`PLAN`**) to snap directly to each elevation on your blueprint, or click **📦 Export GLB (Xogot)** to download the textured `.glb` file.
